description: This file implements Windows-specific network change notification logic for Chromium, including connection type detection, event handling, and integration with Windows network management interfaces.

classes.name: NetworkCostManagerEventSink
classes.description: Event sink class for handling network cost change notifications via COM interfaces on Windows 10+.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::NetworkChangeNotifierWin
methods.description: Constructor initializing network change notifier, setting up event overlapped structure, and initial connection type.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::~NetworkChangeNotifierWin
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources, unregistering event sinks, and stopping address change watching.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::NetworkChangeCalculatorParamsWin
methods.description: Static method returning network change calculation parameters with specific delay values.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::RecomputeCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Static method that determines current network connection type by querying Windows network services.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::RecomputeCurrentConnectionTypeOnBlockingSequence
methods.description: Posts a task to recompute connection type on a background thread and calls a callback with the result.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::GetCurrentConnectionCost
methods.description: Returns the current network connection cost, updating it if necessary.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::InitializeConnectionCostOnce
methods.description: Initializes the connection cost interface via COM.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::InitializeConnectionCost
methods.description: Ensures connection cost is initialized, called once.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::UpdateConnectionCostFromCostManager
methods.description: Queries the current connection cost from Windows network list manager.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::ConnectionCostFromNlmCost
methods.description: Converts Windows NLM connection cost enum to internal enum.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::SetCurrentConnectionCost
methods.description: Sets the current connection cost value.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::OnCostChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when network cost changes, notifying observers if needed.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::ConnectionCostObserverAdded
methods.description: Registers for network cost change notifications when an observer is added.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback invoked when network address change event is signaled; triggers re-evaluation.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::NotifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies observers of a network connection type change, with delayed re-evaluation.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::WatchForAddressChange
methods.description: Starts watching for network address changes, with retries on failure.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::WatchForAddressChangeInternal
methods.description: Internal method to initiate address change notification with Windows API.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::NotifyParentOfConnectionTypeChangeImpl
methods.description: Completes connection type change notification, manages offline polling and bandwidth updates.
